args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before promotion; investigate root cause and the release gate before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The error rate fell from 18% on v2.3.1 to 0.2%, and the service passes health checks.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. It says what failed, what I rolled back and the results afterwards.

The test version of v2.3.1 was also failing health checks in staging before it went to production. I noted in the incident that the cause should be found, and the check that let it through reviewed, before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
